# CHARACTER FLOW kit — 3D character stories with an automatic director

`node SKILL_DIR/new-project.mjs [folder] --kit=characterflow` copies the starter plus this kit
(its `src/` into `src/` and `scripts/` into `scripts/`; the source ships packed, so never copy it by hand). It adds
`src/kits/characterflow/`, `src/stories/` and six scripts, and needs only the starter's packages. Node ≥ 22.13
(the TypeScript director runs with type stripping; `make.mjs` adds the flag itself on 22.13–22.17).

| Folder | Content |
|---|---|
| `character/` | `spec.ts` (10 looks: `RAKA`/`RAKA_OUT`, `NAYA`, `BIMA`, `FRIEND` = dimas, `BOSS`, `SARI`, `DINDA`, `IBU`, `AYAH`, `ADIT`; per-story outfits in `director/compile.ts` `lookSpec`), `pose.ts`, `skeleton.ts` (FK + 2-bone IK arms with hand orientation, legs with planted ankle + foot targets), `Character.tsx`, `Head.tsx` (6 hair styles incl. `long` and `hijab`, glasses, moustache, eyes/lids/brows/mouth/blush), `performance.ts` (beat engine: body, armL, armR, face, look channels; blinks, saccades, breath, sigh, tremble), `presets/` bodies, gestures, 26 expressions |
| `locomotion/` | `walk.ts` (Walker: speed keys → planted footsteps, heel strikes for audio), `stand.ts` (turns with re-planted feet, sit ↔ stand on a seat) |
| `env/` | `registry.ts` (EnvData: bounds, camera keep-out spheres, view side, walk path, marks, seats, bed, light/grade per time), `Campus.tsx`, `Bedroom.tsx` (+ live `Blanket.tsx`), the room kit `room.data.ts` + `Room.tsx` (classroom, office, café, living room as data: walls, windows, door, furniture, seats, marks), `components.tsx` |
| `camera/shots.ts` | 18 shot presets, `onViewSide`, occlusion-aware `safeCam`, `peopleBlock` / `orbitCam` |
| `director/` | `story.ts` (the story spec: places / scenes, cast + outfits), `validate.ts` (plain-language errors, scene by scene), `compile.ts` (scenes → one production per place; blocking, acting, props, thoughts, shot choice, sound cues, music sections), `StoryFilm.tsx` (renders any story, switching places on the VO clock) |
| `fx/`, `captions/`, `props/`, `render/`, `lib/`, `look/` | thought bubbles + icons + vignettes, pop-up board + tumbleweed, word captions + title cards, phone + sling bag, lights + post, `CharLook` proof sheet |
| `Films.tsx` | `<CharacterFlowFilms />` — every story as `<id>-preview` (540×960 @ 30) and `<id>-final` (1080×1920 @ 60), plus `CharacterFlowLook` |
| `src/stories/` | `registry.ts` + `data/` — generated by `make.mjs` from `stories/<id>/story.json` |
| `scripts/` | `make.mjs` (validate → direct → sound → stills/preview/final → QA), `transcribe.mjs` (whisper.cpp or script alignment), `tts.mjs` (macOS offline narration), `sound-story.ts` + `synth.ts` (synthesized ambience per place, foley, SFX, music, ducking), `qa.mjs` (13 checks + contact sheets; `make.mjs` writes the `REVIEW.md` gate) |
| `examples/` | `teman-lama.story.json` (campus, 2 people), `menunda.story.json` + `menunda.script.txt` (bedroom, 1 person) — format references |

## Commands

```
node scripts/transcribe.mjs <vo.mp3> --id=<id> [--script=<text>] [--lang=id]   # VO → public/audio/<id>.*, stories/<id>/words.json
node scripts/tts.mjs stories/<id>/script.txt public/audio/<id>.mp3 --words=stories/<id>/words.json   # only with approval
node scripts/make.mjs stories/<id>/story.json --stills=2,8,14   # validate + direct + sound + stills
node scripts/make.mjs stories/<id>/story.json --preview         # 540×960 @ 30 with sound
node scripts/make.mjs stories/<id>/story.json --final           # 1080×1920 @ 60 + master + 13 QA checks + REVIEW.md (re-run resumes)
node scripts/stills.mjs out/look 0,12 CharacterFlowLook         # character proof sheet
```

`new-project.mjs --kit=characterflow` adds `<CharacterFlowFilms />` to `src/Root.tsx` (from `root.json`); after a
manual copy `make.mjs` does it on its first run. Other styles' compositions stay.

## Check the kit on a new machine

1. `node scripts/stills.mjs out/look 0,12 CharacterFlowLook` — two character cards render.
2. With a TTS voice (macOS): copy `examples/menunda.script.txt` + `menunda.story.json` to `stories/menunda/`, run
   `tts.mjs` as above, then `make.mjs … --stills=2,9,20` — a seated girl thinking, on her phone, standing and pointing.

## Extending (development work, only when the buyer asks)

New environment: `references/characterflow/environments.md` (a room = one more layout in `env/room.data.ts`).
New look: add a `CharacterSpec` in `character/spec.ts` and its name in `director/compile.ts` (`LOOKS`),
`director/story.ts` (`CastLook`) and `director/validate.ts`. New action: a verb in
`director/story.ts`, its acting in `compile.ts`, its shot in `SINGLE`, its sound in `sound-story.ts`; then stills of every
environment. Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and re-render the examples after any engine change.
